title: Use a better placeholder icon for widgets that failed to load
line: Widgets that failed to load now show a red error icon in panels instead of their usual icon or the Plasma logo.
explanation: When a widget fails to load, Plasma replaces it with the shell's AppletError item, but in a panel only its compact representation is visible, and that is the default icon representation showing Plasmoid.icon or, with no metadata, the generic Plasma icon. A broken launcher therefore looked like a working one until clicked. AppletError.qml now sets Plasmoid.icon to dialog-error, the same icon its expanded error view already shows.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: show an error icon for widgets that failed to load

A widget that failed to load kept its own icon in panels, or the generic
Plasma icon when it was missing, so it could look like a working widget
until clicked. The error placeholder now uses the dialog-error icon.

BUG: 524759
